companion.title: Companion Plugin Precision Model Config
companion.notLoaded: Companion plugin (astrbot_plugin_private_companion) not found. Please install and enable it first.
companion.unconfiguredExplain: Unconfigured keys are provider fields supported by the companion plugin but not set yet. Those scenarios either do not need a dedicated model, or fall back to another configured model automatically.
companion.unconfiguredHowto: To make a scenario use a dedicated model, open the companion plugin's config page (Feature Toggles → General Capabilities / Model/Provider → Quick Config) and fill in the matching key; it will then appear here.
companion.usedModelsEmpty: No models are configured in the companion plugin's precision config.
companion.usedModelsCount: {n} models in use (unchanged entries keep their original value)
companion.simpleExplain: Replace by model name: a model is replaced wherever it is used, whether as primary or fallback.
companion.advancedExplain: Replace primary and fallback models separately.
companion.runtimeOutOfSync: The companion plugin still holds the old value in memory; reload it in AstrBot's plugin manager before checking.

companion.overviewExplain: Lists every companion-plugin purpose and its current model. Unconfigured entries can be set directly from the primary/fallback dropdown and saved instantly.

plugins.explain: Scans the config of every installed plugin and lists the model-related entries so you can change them here. Entries are detected in three ways: declared model pickers in the plugin schema (most reliable — empty ones are listed as “Not set” and can be configured right here), values matching a loaded model name / provider ID, and key-name hints (marked as low confidence, hidden by default). Changes are saved immediately, but a few plugins cache config at startup and need a reload.
plugins.stats: {p} / {total} plugins have model config, {n} entries; {m} loaded providers
plugins.batchHint: applies to the currently filtered list only
plugins.emptyAll: No matching plugin or model config.
plugins.hiddenLow: {n} low-confidence entries are hidden (usually the plugin's own models, e.g. drawing models or LoRA filenames) — click to show
plugins.noConfig: This plugin has no _conf_schema.json, so AstrBot never created a config object for it and it cannot be edited here.
plugins.noEntry: No model-related entry found in this plugin's config (it may simply use no model, or the values are empty).
plugins.tagConflictTip: The same key has different values in multiple places (e.g. a flat legacy copy and a nested group). Both are listed; please review and unify.
plugins.tagUnresolvedTip: The value matches no loaded provider / model — the model may have been deleted, or this field is not a model at all.
plugins.tagLowTip: Guessed from the key name only (e.g. a plugin's own drawing model or LoRA filename) — not necessarily an AstrBot provider. Hidden by default; please verify before changing.
plugins.tagMirroredTip: This key exists as a mirror copy (flat top-level + nested group) and will be synced together when written.
plugins.clearNotSupported: Clearing config is not supported here; use the plugin's own config page.
plugins.unknownValue: Note: {v} is not among the loaded models — it may be a custom model name.
